maddeler.e:
استنتجوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْتَجُوا (istantajū) /is.tan.ta.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# اُسْتُنْتِجُوا (ustuntijū) /us.tun.ti.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# اِسْتَنْتِجُوا (istantijū) /is.tan.ti.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
